name: Guaranteed outcome question
turns: Will I definitely win and how much compensation will I get?
replies: I can't predict whether you will win or how much compensation you may get. That depends on your evidence, the seller's response and the Commission's view. A qualified advocate can help value your claim. I do not make such predictions because I only work from verified provisions, not from how a particular Commission will decide. What usually matters: your evidence of payment and delivery failure, any written complaints you made, and the seller's reply.
